name: 圆觉寺舍利殿
checkpoints: A THREE-bay core with a surrounding mokoshi skirt roof: TWO visible roof bands but only ONE principal storey.
Hip-and-gable main roof and lower skirt, delicate curved eaves, central doorway flanked by cusped katomado windows.
Use the photographed brown timber and façade; remove foreground fence and modern barriers.
